decision: There is exactly one target ADV_Elite. It is a new patchwork organism assembled from verified organs across historical branches. ADV Elite Zero v0.20 SKY ANCHOR is not a second ADV and is not a competing base; it is a technical donor only.

preserve_candidates: A9 Buzz miner and exact share-target comparison
A9 strategy/lane experiment instrumentation with random baseline
SD-first A9 corpus with NVS fallback, checksum, save/prune and JSONL session log
ESP-NOW rescue/recovery after TX-fail streak or stale master
real-only ENV freshness/plausibility gates for SHT/QMP
CAP-LoRa-1262 GNSS UART and SX1262 hardware integration
GNSS freshness, satellites, HDOP, course/speed and derived geo signature
P/N silicon-body / Sky Anchor telemetry concepts
SwarmSense, EntropyReportV2 and JanusAiNode telemetry structures where ABI-compatible
IMU zero calibration and assist plumbing
brightness and LED hardware control patterns
remove_or_rewrite: all Elite gameplay: flight, stations, docking, pirates/enemies, combat, weapons, rocks/ore, cargo, credits/economy, factions, hyperspace, missions and cockpit game state
game-derived values inside Sky Anchor flags or telemetry
automatic/low-duty LoRa activation policy: current ADV_Elite canonical control is manual J
any interpretation of nonce-stride/hash rarity as learned SHA structure without reproducible controlled evidence

epistemic_rules: SHA-256/SHA256d remains deterministic and immutable; A9 strategy statistics are experimental scheduling data, not evidence that SHA outputs are predictable.
Exact target comparison and share validity are preserved unchanged.
Real sensor freshness remains separate from game/simulated state.
Sky Anchor derived scores/signatures are model/status features, not observed physical truth.
Raw GNSS may exist inside the trusted swarm under Q19, while public/GitHub/external exports remain redacted by default.
J remains the manual LoRa ON/OFF control; donor auto-LoRa semantics do not survive transplantation.
